{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Read the data
df = pd.read_csv('data/sales.csv')

# Inspect the data
print("Shape:", df.shape)
print("\nFirst few rows:")
print(df.head())

print("\nData types:")
print(df.dtypes)

print("\nMissing values:")
print(df.isnull().sum())

print("\nUnique values in channel:")
print(df['channel'].unique())

print("\nUnique values in status:")
print(df['status'].unique())

print("\nUnique values in customer_segment:")
print(df['customer_segment'].unique())

print("\nExample of revenue:")
print(df['revenue'].head())

# Check for QA orders
qa_orders = df[df['revenue'] == '999999.99']
print(f"\nNumber of QA orders (revenue = 999999.99): {len(qa_orders)}")

# Check for refunded orders
refunded_orders = df[df['status'] == 'refunded']
print(f"\nNumber of refunded orders: {len(refunded_orders)}")

# Check for sentinel values in customer_age
sentinel_age = df[df['customer_age'] == -1]
print(f"\nNumber of rows with customer_age = -1: {len(sentinel_age)}")

# Check if revenue is indeed string with commas
print("\nSample of revenue values:")
print(df['revenue'].sample(5))"}
